_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id} katika mchezo wa LinesOfAction.
Vipande vyako ni '{side}', vipande vya mpinzani ni '{other}'.
Fomu ya kusonga: `[b1b3]` (viwianishi vya chanzo hadi viwianishi vya mwisho). Kusonga kwa sheria husafiri wima, mlalo, au diagonally idadi ya miraba sawa na jumla ya vipande (rangi yoyote) katika mstari huo. Unaweza kuruka juu ya vipande vyako, lakini si vipande vya mpinzani; kutua kwenye mpinzani humkamata.  Ushindi wakati vipande vyote vimeunganishwa kwa 8-jirani.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mĩandĩko nĩyaĩle kwĩthĩwa yĩ mĩaonĩ ya "e2 e4" (kuma,kũka) na "coordinates".
invalid_move.identical: Mahali pa kuanzia na pa kwenda ni sawa.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Husogeo inapaswa kuwa moja kwa moja au ya diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Unapaswa kusonga umbali unaolingana na vipande kwenye mstari.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Andũ ala mavĩtĩte nĩmeesĩ nzĩa ĩla ĩtonya kũvikĩwa.
invalid_move.destination_own: Mahali unapokwenda panashikiliwa na kipande chako.
